documents.text: Mira built LedgerFox, an escrow payment service using PostgreSQL transactions and idempotency keys to prevent duplicate transfers.
Mira developed AtlasFind, a semantic document search application using Python, sentence embeddings and a vector database.
Mira trained a convolutional neural network to classify plant disease from leaf photographs. The held-out image dataset achieved 92 percent accuracy.
During a robotics lab internship, Mira optimized path planning and reduced simulated robot navigation time by 18 percent.
Mira completed a Bachelor of Computer Science at Cedar University in 2024, with a GPA of 3.7 out of 4.
Mira led a student developer club of 30 members and organized six peer programming workshops.
Mira uses Docker, Redis, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions for backend deployment, caching and continuous integration.
Mira built an accessible event calendar in React and TypeScript, with keyboard navigation and screen reader labels.
Mira earned second place in the regional GreenCode hackathon for an energy consumption dashboard.
Mira published a tutorial explaining SQL joins, database indexes and query execution plans.
Mira volunteered at a community library, teaching basic computer literacy to adult learners.
Mira prototyped a Flutter mobile weather application that caches forecasts for offline use.
